note: Photographs #59-64, 66 and 67 in Dorin's numbered photo labels (Canon 6D, July 2021): a tea house in West London, for Jaillon Studio (Paris). Location given only as West London. #51-55 (square edits of the same scenes), #56-57 (garden and street exteriors), #58 (venue sign) and #65 (near-duplicate of #64) are left out. A reflection of the photographer and a passer-by are blurred.

tea-house-01.alt: The finished tea room: a bold green-and-gold feather wallpaper on every wall, hung behind arched mirrors, patchwork armchairs and round walnut tables set for tea.

tea-house-02.alt: The feather wallpaper behind three arched mirrors, the large-scale pattern running unbroken around them above the tables and armchairs.

tea-house-03.alt: Two arched mirrors set into the feather wallpaper above a table laid for tea and a feather-print armchair.

tea-house-04.alt: An arched mirror framed by the feather wallpaper, the pattern centred on the mirror and matched across the drops.

tea-house-05.alt: Close view of the feather wallpaper beside a mirror, its gold quills crisp to the frame, above a table with a teacup and pastry.

tea-house-06.alt: The garden room: a panoramic scenic wallpaper of a swan lake and flowering hydrangeas, with gilt-framed mirrors, two armchairs and a tea table.

tea-house-07.alt: Detail of the scenic swan-lake wallpaper behind a tea table, its hydrangeas and swans running beneath a gilt frame.

tea-house-08.alt: The tea counter: the feather wallpaper above a tiled bar, with an espresso machine, a silver cake stand and pink velvet stools.
